newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Anglo Irish raises $125mln through pref issue.
newsitem.headline: Anglo Irish raises $125mln through pref issue.

text.p: Anglo Irish Bank said on Monday that it was raising 125 million by way of a preference share issue.
Anglo said in a statement that the issue was fully underwritten by Merrill Lynch.
It said the preference shares were non-cumulative, undated and redeemable at the option of the Bank only and the dividend payable on the shares was approximately 8.25 percent per annum.

"The preference share issue, ranking as Tier 1 Capital, represents a positive step in the ongoing development of the Bank's capital base," Anglo said. "It increases the Tier 1 ratio to 11.9 percent and the total capital ratio to 17.8 percent, thus positioning the Bank for further long term growth."
Anglo said the issue will enable Anglo to avail of suitable acquisition opportunities although it has not been done with any specific acquisition in mind.
The timing of the issue was prompted by the fact that the market was receptive, the pricing was favourable and it strengthened Anglo's capital base, Anglo said.
